允许对指定资源执行 SELECT 查询操作，读取表中的数据。这是最基本的数据访问: Allows executing SELECT queries on the specified resource to read data from tables. This is the most basic data access privilege.
允许向指定表中插入新数据。通常用于数据导入、ETL 作业等场景。: Allows inserting new data into the specified table. Typically used for data import, ETL jobs, and similar scenarios.
允许修改指定表中已存在的数据记录。需要谨慎授予，可能影响数据完整性。: Allows modifying existing data records in the specified table. Grant with caution, as it may affect data integrity.
允许删除指定表中的数据记录。高风险操作，建议仅授予必要人员。: Allows deleting data records from the specified table. High-risk operation; recommend granting only to necessary personnel.
允许在指定数据库中创建新表。: Allows creating new tables in the specified database.
允许在指定数据库中创建视图。: Allows creating views in the specified database.
允许创建物化视图，用于加速查询。: Allows creating materialized views to accelerate queries.
允许删除指定的数据库对象（表、视图等）。高风险操作，删除后数据不可恢复。: Allows deleting the specified database objects (tables, views, etc.). High-risk operation; data cannot be recovered after deletion.
允许修改指定对象的结构，如添加列、修改表属性等。: Allows modifying the structure of the specified object, such as adding columns or changing table properties.
允许将自己拥有的权限授予其他用户或角色。具有此权限的用户可以进行权限分发。: Allows granting permissions you own to other users or roles. Users with this permission can distribute privileges.
允许使用指定的 Catalog 或资源。这是访问外部数据源的基础权限。: Allows using the specified Catalog or resource. This is the fundamental permission for accessing external data sources.
表示用户被授予了一个角色，该角色包含一组预定义的权限。: Indicates the user has been granted a role that contains a set of predefined permissions.
允许管理 SQL 黑名单，可以添加或删除被禁止执行的 SQL 模式。这是系统管理: Allows managing the SQL blacklist, including adding or removing banned SQL patterns. This is a system administration permission used to block specific dangerous queries.
允许管理集群节点，包括添加、删除 BE/CN 节点等操作。这是集群管理权限。: Allows managing cluster nodes, including adding or removing BE/CN nodes. This is a cluster administration permission.
管理员权限，拥有系统的完全控制能力。: Administrator permission with full control over the system.
拥有指定资源上的所有权限，等同于该资源的完全控制权。: Grants all permissions on the specified resource, equivalent to full control of that resource.
允许导出表数据到外部存储。: Allows exporting table data to external storage.
允许执行数据导入操作，如 Stream Load、Broker Load 等。: Allows performing data import operations such as Stream Load and Broker Load.
允许模拟其他用户执行操作。高风险权限，需谨慎授予。: Allows performing operations as another user. High-risk permission; grant with caution.
允许执行运维操作，如 KILL 查询、设置系统变量等。: Allows performing operations tasks, such as KILL queries and setting system variables.
允许创建外部资源，如 Spark 资源、Hive 资源等。: Allow creating external resources such as Spark and Hive.
允许创建资源组，用于资源隔离和管理。: Allows creating resource groups for resource isolation and management.
X 权限允许执行相关操作。: The X permission allows performing related operations.
数据分析、报表查询、BI 工具连接: Data analysis, report queries, BI tool connections
数据导入、ETL 作业、实时写入: Data import, ETL jobs, real-time ingestion
阻止危险 SQL、防止资源滥用: Block dangerous SQL, prevent resource abuse
整个集群范围，影响所有数据库和表: Cluster-wide scope, affects all databases and tables
角色 X 包含的所有权限: All permissions contained in role X
全局级别 - 影响整个集群: Global level - affects the entire cluster
数据库级别 - 特定数据库权限: Database level - permission for a specific database
表级别 - 特定表权限: Table level - permission for a specific table
角色 - 通过角色获得的权限: Role - permission obtained through a role
